payload.title: The farm NATS AI path carries no caller identity: all 40 request.farm.ai.* read subjects and request.farm.createTask accept a tenantId-only payload, so farm-service answers with tenant-wide farm data and writes AI tasks under an unchecked createdBy string without any module-grant or site-scope decision
evidence: libs/event-contracts/src/farm-ai-queries.ts:91 (AiQueryRequest is { tenantId } only; the contract has no caller field)
libs/event-contracts/src/farm-ai-queries.ts:95 (AiQueryErrorCode is INVALID_REQUEST | INTERNAL_ERROR; no FORBIDDEN outcome exists)
apps/farm-service/src/common/nats/ai-query-responder.ts:42 (the single chokepoint for all forty subjects runs the handler under withTenantContext(payload.tenantId) after a shape check only)
apps/ai-service/src/tools/farm/farm-ai-query.tool.ts:50 (request is model fields plus ctx.tenantId; ctx.userId, declared at tools/core/tool.interface.ts:58, is never sent)
apps/farm-service/src/task/responders/create-task.responder.ts:55 (createTask only checks createdBy is non-empty, then writes the task under payload.createdBy at :89-94)
payload.rule_violated: D2 (farm-private data is reachable only with the farm grant) and the site-assignment default, which together require that an AI tool never reads or writes more than its human caller could.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-09, release R5.
